Name: Bose Wired Earphones
Details: Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds - in-Ear Headphones, USB-C Connection, Included Carry Case, in-Line Remote and Microphone, Black
product: Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds (USB-C, in-line mic/remote, carry case) – Black, SKU 906940-0010
assumption: Used the Black variant of the new 2026 Bose USB-C wired ANC earbuds. 'Postcode 78' isn't a valid AU postcode, so delivery is listed as standard or free shipping. Prices are the AU RRP; I found no discounts. I couldn't check Amazon AU, Officeworks, Big W or Kogan, because searches returned no listing

best.why: Every AU retailer I found lists $169 and none is discounted. The Good Guys page shows $169 with an Add to Cart button and price beat. Stock is unconfirmed, and the page may still show a 15 Oct pre-order date. JB Hi-Fi shows 'Not available'. Bose AU is $169.95 and still marked pre-order.

offers.notes: Page shows $169 and Add to Cart. A search snippet said pre-order with a 15 Oct 2026 release date, which has passed. Stock status not confirmed. Price beat available.
Page shows $169 but availability is 'Not available'. Will price match.
The price was read from the Dewdrop Mint colour page, which is marked Preorder. The Black price wasn't shown separately, so it's assumed to be the same. Ships in 2-4 days once available.

tips: No retailer is undercutting the others, so price-match isn't needed. JB Hi-Fi, The Good Guys and Harvey Norman will match each other, so buy from whichever has stock.
Harvey Norman also lists the White variant. I couldn't confirm its Black price or stock.
Black Friday and Cyber Monday are about a month away. Bose items often drop then, but a new release may not.
Check ShopBack or Cashrewards for cashback on Bose AU, The Good Guys and JB Hi-Fi before buying.
The postcode '78' isn't valid in Australia. Re-send a 4-digit postcode to get an exact delivery cost.
